name: Metallic
description: Born from raw metal and gradually forged into something that cannot bend or break. Unlocks the Iron Will [Z] hardening stance.

phases.name: Phase 1: Scrap
phases.effects: A crude discarded metal shard. Base 24 DMG and 196 HP.
phases.notification: I was discarded once. Now, I have another purpose.

phases.name: Phase 2: Forged
phases.effects: The metal has passed through intense forge fire. Base 48 DMG and 707 HP.
phases.notification: The heat changed me. I will not remain weak.

phases.name: Phase 3: Tempered
phases.effects: Hammered and water-quenched, crystalline steel forms. Base 153 DMG and 1,958 HP.
phases.notification: Every strike leaves a mark. Every mark makes me harder.

phases.name: Phase 4: Steelbound
phases.effects: Solid steel plating. Unlocks Iron Will [Z] (46% DMG reduction & retaliatory shrapnel for 6.9s). Base 434 DMG and 5,220 HP.
phases.notification: I have learned to endure. Strike me again.

phases.name: Phase 5: Reinforced
phases.effects: Layered steel laminated across the spine. Base 1,041 DMG and 11,963 HP.
phases.notification: Another layer. Another weakness removed. I am becoming stronger.

phases.name: Phase 6: Hardened
phases.effects: Unmatched metallurgical density under crushing pressure. Base 2,168 DMG and 26,100 HP.
phases.notification: Pressure does not frighten me. Pressure creates me.

phases.name: Phase 7: Forgemaster
phases.effects: The blade commands the ancient fire and anvil. Base 4,553 DMG and 54,375 HP.
phases.notification: The earth gave me my material. The forge gave me my purpose.

phases.name: Phase 8: Iron Fortress
phases.effects: Bastion plating encases the user in unyielding armor. Base 9,105 DMG and 119,625 HP.
phases.notification: I no longer need a shield. I am the shield.

phases.name: Phase 9: Unyielding
phases.effects: Impervious to any force that attempts to bend or break it. Base 16,259 DMG and 228,375 HP.
phases.notification: You cannot bend me. You cannot break me.

phases.name: Phase 10: Eternal Steel
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ETERNAL STEEL. Monolithic, perfectly refined divine blade. Base 24,930 DMG, 391,500 HP, and 125 SPD. I do not bend. I do not break. I endure.
phases.notification: I do not bend. I do not break. I endure.
